Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed site plans and square footage; robust condition assessment covering HVAC, roofs, electrical, plumbing, lighting, technology infrastructure, and accessibility; connects condition data to student outcomes and instructional priorities; identifies immediate and long-term needs integrated into capital planning (Sections 5.2, 5.3, 5.5).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides comprehensive enrollment analysis with detailed methodology using birth rates, cohort survival, and demographic data; detailed capacity utilization by site and grade with square footage and classroom counts; links enrollment projections to facility needs and discusses potential impacts of housing developments; includes strategies for adapting space (Sections 3, 4).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle; detailed discussion of 21st century learning environments, flexible classrooms, technology integration, and project-based learning; facility projects directly respond to educational goals including STEM labs, digital learning centers, and collaborative spaces (Sections 1.2, 5, 6).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Provides data and analysis of outdoor spaces including playgrounds, shade structures with photovoltaic panels, and campus landscaping; identifies strategies for improvement such as resurfacing playgrounds and walkways; mentions connections between greening and wellness but coverage is site-specific rather than districtwide (Sections 5.2.4, 5.3.4).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges energy efficiency and renewable energy installations (solar panels) but does not provide a detailed climate risk assessment or comprehensive climate resilience strategies; climate readiness is not a central theme of the plan (Sections 1.1.3, 5).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Includes energy efficiency strategies such as solar installations and HVAC upgrades; discusses energy resilience goals; references state requirements (Title 24, Zero Net Energy) and renewable energy programs; lacks comprehensive district-wide energy use data and detailed electrification or microgrid plans (Sections 1.1.3, 5, 6).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents a comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates, phased project prioritization, and multiple funding sources including bonds, certificates of participation, and state aid; includes cost estimating methods and escalation assumptions; aligns financial capacity with district priorities and long-term sustainability (Section 7).
